outcome: Pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic profiles of tranexamic acid
Safety outcomes (plasma thrombin generation, D-dimer, breast milk tranexamic acid concentration)
cohort: 30 pregnant women undergoing scheduled cesarean delivery
finding: Intravenous tranexamic acid administered at umbilical cord clamping was well-tolerated at all doses tested, and a dose of 600mg is proposed for future efficacy studies on postpartum hemorrhage prevention.
mod_finding: This study focused on tranexamic acid dosage for postpartum hemorrhage prevention in women undergoing scheduled cesarean delivery and did not compare outcomes based on mode of delivery.
